name: Insight Lifetech Co. Ltd.
summary: Insight Lifetech Co., Ltd. operates as a medtech company. Its products include coronary physiology, coronary imaging, and coronary catheters. The firm also offers exchange fractional flow reserve (FFR) microcatheters, cardiovascular pressure measurement (CPM) systems, intravascular ultrasound systems, and microcatheters for complex percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). The company was founded by Xiao Yang Fu, Song Liang and Li Li Chen on December 11, 2015 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
